<!--
Use a Conventional Commit PR title: <type>[optional scope][!]: <description>
Examples: feat(accounts): add user profiles; docs: clarify recovery steps.
See CONTRIBUTING.md for commit types and breaking-change guidance.
-->

## Problem and behavior

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List the commands/checks run and their results. State what was not exercised.
For visible UI changes, include screenshots when useful. For image or account
changes, identify the container/VM checks used and the image or source revision.

## Compatibility and recovery

Describe any upgrade, data-format, authorization or recovery impact, if applicable.
